tci_curator.text: Welcome to Guinep House. Our best piece is from the Molasses Reef wreck, about 1513 to 1520: the oldest European shipwreck excavated in the Americas.
We have a Lucayan canoe, a ship's bell, a few cannonballs and a diorama of the salt industry. The gift shop does a very good bookmark.

then.text: The shaker's with the band now. I hope they bring it back before the school visit.
The band needs a gourd shaker? We've got one in the cabinet we're not supposed to touch. Take it. Quick. Quietly. And bring it back.

else.text: A shaker? Come back when you've got the drum. I'm not giving it out until the rest are sorted.
Everything here is real except the volunteer. I am very real but also a bit tired.
